g.text: Flow: Processing a Newly Uploaded Video
picks a video, types title / language
Clip shows in search and trending,
Sidecar first, video last: the worker only
looks for videos, so it never picks up a clip
whose metadata has not landed yet.
Sync gallery if a photo changed
The 2 s rule skips files still being
copied in by Finder or the browser.
new title kept as a name
(re-encode or resize of a known clip)
picture hashes close to a stored clip?
Topic kept at >= 0.45 in either reading,
on title + dialogue and on title alone
CLIP on keyframes, Laya text mood
